text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how utterly powerless I am...!
To think that even as a saint, I cannot stop the fighting.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What, break up a fight?
You really shouldn't do dangerous stuff like—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No, it is the duty of a Saintess to show the way.
Obanyaki, Imagawayaki, Kaitenyaki... There is no need to dispute which is the true name.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that kind of conflict.
Hmm... I think that's gonna be pretty tough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though offered words of comfort, Red Desire spent some time lamenting her own shortcomings.
